font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
.top { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 24px; align-items: start; margin-bottom: 20px; }
h1 { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(42px, 7vw, 86px); line-height: .9; letter-spacing: 0; }
.links { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: end; }
.button { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 10px 13px; background: rgba(16, 23, 31, .84); font-weight: 750; }
.stage { min-width: 1120px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; align-items: stretch; }
.lane { min-height: 680px; background: rgba(16, 23, 31, .94); border: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr auto; overflow: hidden; }
.lane-head { padding: 14px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }

.meter span { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
.meter strong { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font: 800 20px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; white-space: nowrap; }
.chat { padding: 14px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(12, 19, 25, .96), rgba(7, 12, 16, .98)); }

.msg { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); animation: rise .24s ease forwards; max-width: 92%; padding: 9px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .035); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.35; }
.msg.tool { align-self: stretch; max-width: 100%; color: #ffe9aa; border-color: rgba(245, 199, 93, .42); font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; }
.toolrail h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.tool-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; color: var(--muted); font: 11px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; margin-bottom: 5px; }
.bar { height: 8px; background: #17212a; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #21303a; }
.fill { height: 100%; width: 0%; background: var(--red); transition: width .18s linear; }
.diff { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 68px 1fr; font: 12px/1.42 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; }

.claim { margin-top: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(122, 167, 255, .34); background: rgba(122, 167, 255, .06); padding: 12px 14px; color: var(--muted); font: 13px/1.45 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; }
.ticker { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 14px; background: var(--green); margin-left: 4px; transform: translateY(2px); animation: blink 1s steps(2, start) infinite; }
